title: Booking a Hotel Room: A Quick Guide
description: Join our friendly hosts as they walk you through the simple steps of booking a hotel room, from choosing dates to securing the best deal. Perfect for travelers new to online reservations!
thumbnailPrompt: A cozy studio set with warm orange lighting, a laptop open on a desk showing a hotel booking website, and two hosts smiling at the camera.

scenes.title: Welcome!
scenes.subtitle: Let’s get started.
scenes.imagePrompt: Host 1 in a relaxed pose holding a coffee cup, Host 2 with a laptop open showing a hotel booking site.

audio.text: Hey there! I’m Maya and this is Alex. Today we’re going to show you how easy it is to book a hotel room online. Ready?

scenes.title: Step 1: Pick Your Dates
scenes.subtitle: When are you traveling?
scenes.imagePrompt: Close-up of a calendar on the laptop screen with dates highlighted.

audio.text: First, decide when you’ll be there. Just click on the check-in and check-out dates. It’s as simple as that!

scenes.title: Step 2: Search Hotels
scenes.subtitle: Find your spot.
scenes.imagePrompt: Laptop screen showing a list of hotels with photos and ratings.

audio.text: Now hit search. You’ll see all the options—look at the star rating, price, and reviews to pick what fits you best.

scenes.title: Step 3: Check Room Options
scenes.subtitle: Choose your comfort.
scenes.imagePrompt: Room types displayed with icons for single, double, suite, and amenities like Wi-Fi, breakfast.

audio.text: Click on a hotel to see room choices. Notice the bed type, view, and extras like free breakfast or parking. Pick what matters most!

scenes.title: Step 4: Secure Your Booking
scenes.subtitle: Pay with confidence.
scenes.imagePrompt: Credit card details being entered on a secure website, lock icon visible.

audio.text: Add your room to the cart, enter payment info, and confirm. Make sure you see the booking confirmation email—keep it handy!

scenes.title: Wrap Up
scenes.subtitle: All set!
scenes.imagePrompt: Hosts smiling at camera, laptop open with a confirmed reservation page.

audio.text: And that’s it—your room is booked! If you have any questions, drop them in the comments. Safe travels and see you next time!
